public_definitions: Routing criterion: Whether the period-wide temperature change warrants targeted follow-up.
Option: Route the 2005-2014 temperature change to substantial-change follow-up.
Option: Keep the 2005-2014 temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
Option: Route the temperature record to archive and background filing.
uncertain: The data labels include a dollar sign ('$') before the temperature values (e.g., '$23.9°C'), which is inconsistent with the y-axis unit of °C; it is unclear whether this is a typographical artifact or intentional notation.
No explicit threshold or definition of 'substantial change' versus 'ordinary variation' is provided in the chart or visible context to determine the routing boundary.

The 2011 data point label '$15.3°C' is present but its exact vertical alignment relative to the 2010 point ($15.5°C) is very close, making precise visual differentiation of the small difference difficult.
No legend is present to confirm the single series name beyond the chart title 'Global Temperature Change'.
